subject: geography
title: Tributaries of Major Indian Rivers
description: Ganga, Brahmaputra, Godavari, Krishna, and other major river systems

content.overview: India's river systems are crucial for agriculture, ecology, and culture. Here are the major tributaries.
keyPoints: Ganga: Yamuna, Ghaghara, Gandak, Kosi, Son, Chambal, Betwa, Ken
Yamuna: Chambal, Betwa, Ken, Hindon, Tons, Hindan
Brahmaputra: Subansiri, Siang, Dibang, Lohit, Kameng, Manas, Sankosh, Teesta
Godavari: Pranhita, Indravati, Sabari, Manjira, Wainganga, Penganga
Krishna: Tungabhadra, Bhima, Ghataprabha, Malaprabha, Musi, Munneru
Kaveri: Hemavati, Kabini, Bhavani, Amudhavar, Lakshmana Tirtha
Mahanadi: Seonath, Hasdeo, Mand, Ib, Ong, Tel
Narmada: Tawa, Barna, Hiran, Kolar, Orsang, Kundi
Tapti: Purna, Girna, Panjhra, Bori, Waghur
Beas: Parbati, Sainj, Uhl, Banganga, Luni
Chenab: Chandra, Bhaga, Tawi, Marusudar, Ravi
Jhelum: Lidder, Sind, Neelum, Poonch, Kunhar
Ravi: Budhil, Tundah, Saho, Nai, Baira, Ujh

mnemonics.trick: Y-G-G-K-S-C-B-K = Yamuna, Ghaghara, Gandak, Kosi, Son, Chambal, Betwa, Ken
mnemonics.explanation: Ganga tributaries: Yamuna, Ghaghara, Gandak, Kosi, Son, Chambal, Betwa, Ken

mnemonics.trick: P-I-S-M-W-P = Pranhita, Indravati, Sabari, Manjira, Wainganga, Penganga
mnemonics.explanation: Godavari tributaries: Pranhita, Indravati, Sabari, Manjira, Wainganga, Penganga

quiz.question: Which is the largest tributary of Ganga?
quiz.explanation: Yamuna is the largest tributary of Ganga

quiz.question: Which river is known as 'Sorrow of Bihar'?
quiz.explanation: Kosi is known as 'Sorrow of Bihar' due to frequent floods

quiz.question: Which is the longest tributary of Godavari?
quiz.explanation: Pranhita is the longest tributary of Godavari
